issues.description: The admitted Preset.do source view covers its opening and early producer chain only. Frozen dependency IDs D0016–D0049 remain under this unresolved source-coverage issue because their complete producer, native field, period, and consumer contracts are not established by the readable excerpts. This unread coverage does not itself establish additional mandatory raw datasets or prove data absence.

The LinkUp guide writes Processed_Data/20230227_DEI_data.csv, and Preset.do reads the same basename from Raw_Data/ before renaming the_key_x. D0015 is credited as an author-generated product; aligning the documented output with the consumer directory is a preparation step. The basename alone does not establish complete field, row, or period compatibility.

Analysis.do imports jpv1_6_011825_agg.csv from its working directory. The Glassdoor guide supports a precomputed-input route and a raw rebuild route and exposes --output from a nested default path. Select one route and configure/stage its single aggregate at the consumer path; the four raw inputs are needed together only for the rebuild route. Local output availability is unverified.

The precomputed-input check lists month-year, rcid, and rating_diversity_and_inclusion, while Analysis.do refers to monthyear after import delimited. The source excerpt does not specify enough import-normalization semantics or actual CSV metadata to establish a field defect; Stata may normalize a hyphenated header. Confirm the selected route’s imported field names and firm-month meaning before proposing any rename.

The ESG guide writes 20250605sp_esgscore.dta and Analysis.do reads the matching basename under Raw_Data, then renames assessmentyear to year. D0006 is credited as an author-generated product; moving/configuring that output at the consumer path is preparation. Full source identity and field/row compatibility remain unresolved.
The data sheet lists Capital IQ ESG Score, while the ESG guide labels its CSV as downloaded from S&P ESG ratings. The evidence does not establish whether these refer to the same native source export.

The author data sheet says provider inputs are subscriber-accessible. The assigned catalog returned some local candidates and product/file-name misses, but neither candidate compatibility nor account, subscription, or delivery access was verified. A catalog miss is not evidence of a missing license or data absence outside this SAS catalog.

The registered package inventory contains no raw or processed vendor data files. The assigned SAS catalog lookup nevertheless returned candidate Revelio tables, Compustat annual-fundamentals tables, Capital IQ transcript tables, and several identifier/taxonomy tables; these candidates do not establish author-file compatibility, complete source data, or availability of other formats/workspaces.

The ChatGPT scoring stage has author-prepared input artifacts D0050 and D0051, but their full input paths/contracts are not available in the admitted source evidence and no matching data files are in the registered inventory.

The scoring script imports the OpenAI client; the typed environment proof does not establish the module, account, credential, or API-access status. This is an access uncertainty, not proof of an unavailable account. No external API call was made.
The conference-call guide establishes a WRDS connection, but the account/session route is not verified in the environment evidence. This is an access uncertainty, not proof of unavailable access.

The fund-ownership script requires the Morningstar-manually-matched fund/portfolio workbook. The registered CLM identifiers workbook is distinct; the assigned SAS dataset-catalog lookup found no SAS dataset matching the XLSX filename, which does not establish whether that workbook exists in a separate author workspace.

The registered Revelio public-firm processing guide has zero readable extracted text in the frozen work item. This is a representation limit for this review; it does not show that the guide or code is absent.
Analysis.do uses outreg2, while the typed environment proof reports the exact command unavailable.

Several direct Python and Stata imports/commands are visible in the author sources but are not included as verified keys in the typed environment projection. Their availability is unresolved; import statements do not establish that a module is missing.
